texts.content_exam: Nora Badour is a Syrian disabled weight-lifting heroine. She was born in 1984. She left school at a very early age. She followed a training course in hand-made wool knitting. She participated in several handicraft exhibitions. Because of her friends encouragement, Nora joined the weight-lifting sport. 'My friends said that I could do it' Nora said. She received a special training in the field of weight-lifting. Nora won the Bronze medal in Egypt in 2007 and it was the start of her exceptional career. She broke many world records for many years. But the most remarkable prize was the golden medal in Jordan in 2011. She was honored by the government for her achievements.

texts.source_text: Fatimah Al Hasan - Another Syrian Heroine
texts.content_exam: Fatimah Al hasan is another Syrian disabled heroine. She was born in 1977. She left school in order to help her mother in raising her siblings. With her great determination she could continue her study and had her place at Damascus university. Fatimah had a dream to become a famous person and to overcome her disability. Her dream became true when she won many medals including the golden one in Jordan in 2009 for weight-lifting sport. Fatimah says that sport has changed her social life and strengthened her to prove herself in society. It set her free from her disability and made her believe that nothing is impossible. She can do what even other people cannot do. She will participate in Japan Olympics in 2021. Fatimah believes everybody must follow their dreams and Syria is proud of her.

texts.content_exam: Ruben started skiing at 21, later than most Olympic athletes. He competed in three Winter Olympics: Calgary 1988, Albertville 1992, and Salt Lake City 2002 at age 39. Skiing down a mountain at 90 miles an hour is very dangerous. At that speed, you don't have time to think. The skating board is sensitive and if you fall, you may crash. It takes a couple of hundred meters to stop because you finish at about 80 miles an hour. Ruben still practises skiing but he is frightened of every run. These days, he works as a motivational speaker. He talks about his experiences and how to be successful. He is also making a film about success and interviewing many business people.
